refnamediv.refpurpose: Submit session records and evaluate trust policies

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: pam_platformd.so communicates with platformd-trustd.service8. It does not verify credentials and does not replace an authentication module.

When used as a session module with method=, it submits a record when a session is opened. The record names the PAM service, user, terminal, remote host, logind session, and declared authentication method. The module returns success regardless of submission failure.

A submitted session record is declared audit evidence. It does not establish verification freshness. Freshness is accepted only from a successful platformd-verify verification event submitted for the same logind session.
When used as an auth or account module with policy=, it evaluates the named policy for the caller's logind session. An unreachable service, an interface error, and a denied policy all fail closed.

listitem.para: Record METHOD as the declared authentication method when a session is opened.
Evaluate POLICY for the caller's logind session.

refsect1.title: Return values
refsect1.para: The session module returns PAM_SUCCESS. The auth module returns PAM_SUCCESS for a satisfied policy and PAM_AUTH_ERR otherwise. The account module returns PAM_SUCCESS for a satisfied policy and PAM_PERM_DENIED otherwise. A module invocation without a supported argument returns PAM_IGNORE.

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.programlisting: session optional pam_platformd.so method=password auth required pam_platformd.so policy=verified-boot
